user.title: Connect to Crow Cloud
user.description: Enter your Crow Cloud account credentials and the MAC address of your alarm panel.

data_description.panel_mac: Enter with or without separators — both 0013A1250A45 and 00:13:A1:25:0A:45 are accepted.
data_description.panel_code: The numeric user code used to arm and disarm the panel. Leave blank if not required.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthentication Required
reauth_confirm.description: The Crow Shepherd integration needs to re-authenticate. Enter updated credentials below.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Crow Cloud. Check your internet connection.
error.no_panel: No alarm panel found with the specified MAC address. Verify the MAC is correct.
error.invalid_mac: Invalid MAC address format. Enter 12 hex characters — e.g. 0013A1250A45 or 00:13:A1:25:0A:45.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the Crow Cloud for updates (10–300 seconds).
data_description.panel_code: The numeric user code used to arm and disarm the panel. Leave blank if not required.

bypass_zone.name: Bypass Zone
bypass_zone.description: Bypass or unbypass a zone on the alarm panel.

zone_id.name: Zone ID
zone_id.description: The numeric ID of the zone to bypass or unbypass.

bypass.name: Bypass
bypass.description: True to bypass, false to unbypass.
